285117135.description:
Natural amethyst crystal cluster with many pointed purple crystals rising from a banded white and gray base. The back is a rough, uncut matrix with green and rust colored mineral staining. A small display piece suited to a shelf, desk or mineral collection.

Condition: Pre-owned, no visible damage. Rough natural back with green and rust colored staining. Some tiny crystal tips show natural variation.

285551550.description: This collection features four natural mineral and stone pieces, including an amethyst crystal cluster with druzy points on matrix, a natural smoky quartz crystal point/cluster, a rough smoky quartz specimen, and a carved green soapstone figure titled "Where the Forest Go" #9508, signed by artist John Craig Loveing Bear. The carved figure depicts an abstract animal form with mottled green and black veining characteristic of soapstone, featuring a polished finish mounted on a rectangular base with visible tool marks. All pieces display natural mineral characteristics and minor surface wear consistent with age and handling. This vintage collection offers a nice variety for the mineral and art collector.

285688895.description: This lot includes a variety of collectible minerals and crystals such as an amethyst cluster, quartz, and possibly petrified wood. Two gemstone wire bonsai trees are featured, one with citrine-like stones and the other with dark blue or purple stones. There are also small tumbled or raw stones included in the collection. The items show natural wear typical for mineral specimens and are in good condition with no visible damage.
